open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a ⊆ c ++ [h1]) (hb : b ⊆ d ++ [h1]) :
      a ++ b ⊆ (c ++ d) ++ [h1] := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx | hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (ha hx) with hx | hx
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_left _ hx)
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ hx
    · rcases List.mem_append.mp (hb hx) with hx | hx
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_append_right _ hx)
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ hx
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
  all_goals try first
    | exact List.subset_append_left _ _
    | assumption
    | apply join <;> first | assumption | apply join <;> assumption
  split
  · split <;>
      simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.nil_append]
    · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
    · exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  · apply join <;> assumption
